notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA S4 Update Preview
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, thank you for your support for SHOOPER NOVA :3, the S4 Season update is coming soon![/p][p](Note: Due to difficulty adjustments and data changes, to ensure fairness and enjoyment of the Ranking,**[b]old game save data will become invalid after the update[/b]**)[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the main update contents:[/p][list][*][p]New Final Battle: After passing Wave 20, a "Final Battle" option is added. Enter an untimed Wave 21, challenge yourself to survive longer and rank (this will use a separate Ranking leaderboard, this option will take less time).[/p][/*][*][p]New Custom Emoji: You can now import local images and display them on your character's face (supports PNG and GIF image formats).[/p][/*][*][p]Trading Cards Enabled: (Cards, Badges, Emotes, Profile Backgrounds, Animated Avatars; it is said that veteran players will be compensated with dropped cards).[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Workshop Enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Please look forward to more content in the update announcement on the release day :3![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.notes:
[h1]SHOOPER NOVA is about to receive an update![/h1]
[list]
[*]  Enhanced the power of Weapons/Shields/Towers/Scattering/Negative Refinement, and Satellites will become "bigger"
[*]  Enhanced the importance of Component Levels in mid-to-late game
[*]  Component Archive can view components of various levels
[*]  Added 【Enemy Archive】
[*]  Added 【Endless Proving Ground】, which does not participate in ranking, enemies grow slower, Tech cap is doubled, allowing for exploration of more possibilities
[*]  Original 【Endless Trial】 renamed to 【Extreme Challenge】
[*]  Prevent damage loss under low frame rates
[*]  Ranking will enter S3 Season![b]（Note：Save data for unfinished games will become invalid after the update）[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA Future Update Plan! Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Roadmap[/h1]

[h1]Performance Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Continue optimizing mid-to-late game performance.
[/list]

[h1]Shop Experience[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to view and unban items disabled in the current run.
[*] Intuitive visualization of satellite orbits in the shop.
[/list]

[h1]Combat Experience[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjustable projectile effect transparency.
[*] Improved cursor visibility.
[/list]

[h1]Encyclopedia Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Monster Encyclopedia.
[*] Component Encyclopedia will display different component levels.
[/list]

[h1]Buffs for Weaker Builds[/h1]
[list]
[*] Strengthen Firearms.
[*] Strengthen Shields.
[*] Strengthen Shooting Turrets.
[/list]

[h1]Extreme Challenge & Endless Mode[/h1]
Choice available after Wave 20:
[list]
[*] Extreme Challenge: Higher difficulty, includes rank.
[*] Endless Mode: Lower difficulty, no rank, removes tech stacking cap.
[*] Finish Run.
[/list]

[h1]New Features & Workshop[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Gameplay Mode.
[*] Controller vibration feedback.
[*] Key Binding.
[*] Custom player emotes.
[*] Steam Workshop Support.
[/list]

[h1]Wallpaper[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wallpaper Engine audio-responsive wallpaper.
[/list]
